Feature Status

We're building a catalog of reusable BPMN subprocesses.

  • ✅ Monorepo setup with pnpm + Turborepo
  • ✅ Astro 5 + React + Tailwind CSS
  • ✅ BPMN.js integration for interactive diagrams
  • ✅ i18n support (en, de, es)
  • ✅ Content collections for subprocess metadata
  • ✅ Command Palette with Cmd+K search
  • ✅ Faceted Sidebar filters
  • ✅ Netflix-style grid layout
  • ✅ Dark mode support
  • 🔨 Static SVG previews for listing pages
  • 🔨 Pagefind search integration
  • 🔨 GitHub Discussions integration

Technical Stack

Framework

Astro 5 + React 19

Styling

Tailwind CSS 3.4

BPMN Engine

bpmn-js 18
